instruction: Please hide the scrollbars in GIMP.

metadata.explanation: Task requires hiding scrollbars in GIMP. Evaluator checks sessionrc config for show-scrollbars = no. Similar to original hide-docks task.
metadata.verified: Uses existing check_config_status metric and get_gimp_config_file getter. Config keys verified against GIMP sessionrc format.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks GIMP sessionrc config file for scrollbar visibility setting
Getter (get_gimp_config_file) extracts the correct config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/sessionrc
Metric (check_config_status) correctly parses S-expression format and checks for key-value pair (show-scrollbars, no)
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP to ensure config is written to disk before verification
Expected value is semantically correct: show-scrollbars=no is the proper setting for hiding scrollbars in GIMP
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the only requirement in the instruction (hide scrollbars)
